hint_join: Paste the invite, then press JOIN.
hint_connecting: Waiting for the server to answer…
hint_connect: Once everything's in order, press RETRY.
hint_cert: Ask your host for a new invite, then press NEW INVITE.
hint_register: Pick a name, then press REGISTER.
hint_verify: Press VERIFY to check the game.
hint_trust: Review the server's runtime files first.
hint_runtime: A small download, installed next to the game.
hint_runtime_none: The host hasn't published the game runtime yet.
join_text: Paste the invite your host sent you. It starts with reforged-revival://
join_hint: Paste the whole invite. It starts with reforged-revival://
join_ok_public: Looks good: a public server. The connection is encrypted and locked to this server's certificate.
join_ok_private: Looks good: a private server, reached over Tailscale.
join_next: Next, the launcher checks the connection, creates your account, finds your Dauntless 1.14.7 and installs the server's game runtime. The game itself is not downloaded.
invite_err_too_long: That's too long to be an invite.
invite_err_not_invite: That doesn't look like an invite. It should start with reforged-revival://join
invite_err_version: This invite is for a different launcher version. Ask the host for a new one.
invite_err_params: The invite is incomplete or has extra parts. Copy the whole invite again.
invite_err_mode: This invite has an unknown mode. Ask the host for a new one.
invite_err_host: The server address in the invite isn't valid. A private invite must point to a Tailscale address; for a server on the internet, ask your host for a public invite.
invite_err_port: The port in the invite isn't valid.
invite_err_fp: The certificate fingerprint in the invite isn't valid. Copy the whole invite again.
invite_err_name: The server name in the invite isn't valid.
invite_err_share: The Tailscale link in the invite isn't a login.tailscale.com link.
saved_text: Servers you have joined before. Switch to one without pasting its invite again.
saved_other_text: Servers you have joined before. Switch with one click, no invite needed. Your account on each one stays. Remove only takes it off this list.
host_teaser_text: Host tools walk you through everything a Dauntless 1.14.7 server needs: the game's SDK, the game runtime, the game data and the invites for your friends.
link_text: You opened an invite to {name} at {host}. Only join servers you trust.
link_switch_note: Your key for your current server stays on this PC, so you can switch back with its invite.
connect_checking_text: Checking that the server answers over Tailscale.
connect_checking_text_public: Checking the server over an encrypted connection.
connect_ts_text: {name} is a private server. Your PC reaches it through Tailscale, a free app that makes a private connection between you and the host.
connect_step_install: Install Tailscale and sign in with your own account.
connect_step_accept: Accept the host's invite so their PC shows up in your Tailscale.
connect_step_accept_nolink: Accept the share invite the host sent you (a link or an email).
connect_step_retry: Come back here and press RETRY.
connect_cert_title: This is not your friend's server
connect_cert_text: The server at {host} answered with a different security certificate than your invite expects. The launcher stopped before sending anything.
connect_cert_next: If your host set up the server again, ask them for a new invite.
connect_bad_text: Something answered at {host}:{port}, but not like a DaintyLass server. Check the invite with your host.
connect_unreach_text: No answer from {host} within 5 seconds. Check these, then retry:
connect_unreach_text_public: No answer from {host}. Check these, then retry:
connect_check_internet: Your PC is connected to the internet.
connect_check_server: The host's server is running (ask them).
connect_check_firewall: A firewall or antivirus isn't blocking the launcher.
connect_check_ts_on: Tailscale is running and you're signed in.
reg_text: This is the name your friends see on {name}.
reg_invite_missing: No invite code: this works only if the server has open registration.
reg_closed: Registration is closed on this server right now. Ask the host.
reg_rejected_title: Your saved key no longer works
reg_rejected: {name} no longer accepts the key saved on this PC. Register again, or use another key.
reg_have_key: I already have an account key
reg_key_placeholder: Paste your key or the whole backup file
reg_key_note: Your key is stored encrypted on this PC and is never shown.
locate_text: The launcher doesn't download the game: it uses the Dauntless 1.14.7 you already have. Pick the Dauntless folder, the one with Archon inside.
locate_none_title: No Dauntless install found on this PC
locate_none_text: Dauntless 1.14.7 is installed with Legendary from the game's last manifest. The guide shows how; then choose the folder here.
locate_wrong_text: The private server runs only the 1.14.7 build (changelist 647472). Other versions can't connect to it.
locate_wrong_unknown: The game's executable isn't the 1.14.7 build.
locate_wrong_fix: Install 1.14.7 with Legendary (the guide has the manifest to use), then choose that folder.
locate_verify_text: The launcher makes sure the game's executable is exactly the 1.14.7 build. It takes a few seconds: press VERIFY.
locate_missing_title: The game isn't there any more
locate_missing_text: The folder you chose no longer holds Dauntless. Choose it again, or pick another one.
locate_path_note: The Dauntless folder (with Archon inside), the Archon folder and Archon\Binaries\Win64 all work. The game is used where it is: the launcher only adds the server's two runtime files next to it.
runtime_trust_title: This server sends a game runtime
runtime_trust_text: {name} runs Dauntless 1.14.7 through its own game runtime: two files the launcher puts next to the game so it talks to the private server.
runtime_trust_detail: They run inside the game with your Windows permissions. Review them and allow them only for a host you trust.
runtime_install_text: {name} offers a game runtime you have already allowed. It's a small download; every file is checked before it's used.
runtime_none_title: The game runtime isn't ready yet
runtime_none_text: {name} doesn't offer a game runtime yet. The host builds it once, from the game's SDK, before anyone can play.
runtime_none_host_text: Host tools walk you through it: dump the game's SDK with Dumper-7, build the runtime, prepare the game data and publish it to your server.
installing_runtime_text: Downloading the runtime files and checking each one against the server's list.
installing_verify_text: Making sure the game's executable is the Dauntless 1.14.7 build.
backup_title: Save a backup of your key
backup_text: Your account lives in a secret key on this PC. Save a copy somewhere safe, like a password manager or a USB stick, so an operating-system reinstall doesn't cost you your Slayer.
ready_text: Everything's checked and ready. See you in Ramsgate.
gamedata_synthetic_title: This server runs on example game data
gamedata_synthetic_text: The host hasn't exported the real 1.14.7 item catalog yet, so items, loot and progression may be wrong or missing. Fine for a first test; tell the host if something looks off.
gamedata_missing_title: This server is missing game data
gamedata_missing_text: Some of the server's game-data files are missing. You can join, but Ramsgate or the hunts may not start. Tell the host.
running_text: Dauntless is running. PLAY comes back here when the game closes.
running_relay_title: Keep the launcher open while you play
running_relay_text: It carries the game's connection to the server. You can minimise it.
sp_nobody: Nobody's online yet. Be the first!
sp_no_worlds: No worlds are running right now.
sp_unsupported: This server doesn't share live status yet.
sp_nojoin: Join a server to see who's online.
sp_signin: Sign in to see who's online.
sp_no_answer: No answer from the server. The launcher keeps trying in the background.
news_empty: No news yet. Your host can post updates here.
news_offline: News shows up here once you've joined a server.
server_connection_public: Public, encrypted (TLS locked to the certificate in your invite)
server_auto: Updates every 15 seconds while this window is open.
host_intro: Everything a host needs before friends can play Dauntless 1.14.7: the game's SDK, the game runtime, the game data and the server. Each step is detected from the files on this PC.
host_windows_only: Dumping the SDK, building and injecting work only on Windows. You can still read the steps here.
host_ws_text: Your copy of the DaintyLass repository. Its setup downloads Mystic Paradox at the pinned commit, applies the Reforged patches and prepares the server.
host_ws_download_to: The launcher downloads it with Git into {folder}, beside the game.
host_ws_download_no_game: Choose your Dauntless 1.14.7 folder on the Play page: the project is downloaded beside it.
host_sdk_text: The runtime is compiled against an SDK generated from your own copy of the game. It's never downloaded or shipped: you make it once with Dumper-7.
host_sdk_step_dumper: Build or download Dumper-7, then choose its DLL.
host_sdk_step_run: Start the game without the runtime and load Dumper-7 into it. Wait in the main menu until C:\Dumper-7 holds the SDK (a minute or two), then close the game.
host_sdk_need_game: Choose a Dauntless 1.14.7 folder first (Play page).
host_sdk_step_import: Import the newest dump into the runtime source.
host_sdk_none: No dump in C:\Dumper-7 yet. If Dumper-7 wrote it somewhere else, choose its CppSDK folder.
host_sdk_need_setup: The first time, the launcher downloads Mystic Paradox (the code the SDK goes into) before importing: it takes a minute or two.
host_build_text: MysticParadox.dll and CatalogExporter.dll need Visual Studio with the “Desktop development with C++” workload; winmm.dll (the loader) needs Rust.
host_data_text: The server needs the 1.14.7 item catalog and loot tables. Real data is exported from your game with CatalogExporter; example data only lets the server start for a test.
host_data_step_synthetic: For a first test: copy the example data (it never overwrites real files).
host_data_step_export: For real data: press PLAY on your own server, wait in Ramsgate, then inject CatalogExporter.
host_data_need_game: Start the game with PLAY first.
host_data_step_copy: Copy the exported Items_Analysis folder into the workspace.
host_data_step_generate: Generate the server's game-data files from it:
host_data_step_pack: Already generated it once? Import your game data pack (npm run gamedata -- --export makes one) instead of the steps above.
host_publish_text: Copies the built runtime to your content server, so every player's launcher can install it. Players see the file hashes and accept them once.
host_run_title: Run the server and invite friends
host_run_text: Start the server, then make one invite per friend. Each invite holds the address, the certificate fingerprint and a one-time code.
host_err_workspace: Choose your DaintyLass folder (the one with ReforgedHost inside) first.
host_err_folder: That folder doesn't exist yet. Run the step that creates it first.
host_err_no_dump: No Dumper-7 output in C:\Dumper-7. Run the dump first.
host_err_msbuild: MSBuild wasn't found. Install Visual Studio with the “Desktop development with C++” workload.
host_err_cargo: Cargo wasn't found. Install Rust (rustup), then restart the launcher.
host_err_no_exports: There's no Items_Analysis folder next to the game yet. Inject CatalogExporter and wait for it to finish.
host_err_game_not_running: Start the game with PLAY first.
host_err_pack_invalid: That file isn't a game data pack. Make one with npm run gamedata -- --export.
host_err_pack_game: That game data pack is for another Dauntless version.
host_err_pack_damaged: That game data pack is damaged: a file in it doesn't match its hash.
host_err_server_external: The server was started in a terminal: stop it there (Ctrl+C) first.
host_err_multipliers_public: The test multipliers are for private (Tailscale) servers only.
host_err_multipliers_form: Each multiplier is a number from 1 to 100.
host_err_update: The update couldn't be checked. The server details below say why.
host_err_update_not_git: This project folder isn't a git clone, so it can't be updated. Clone it again with git (Requirements tab) and move the .workspace folder into the new clone.
host_err_update_no_upstream: This project folder doesn't follow a branch on GitHub. In a terminal there: git checkout main.
host_err_update_fetch_failed: GitHub couldn't be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
host_err_update_diverged: This project folder has commits of its own that GitHub doesn't have, so it can't be updated by itself. Update it in a terminal (git pull).
host_err_update_local_changes: Files of the project were changed on this PC and the update would overwrite them. In a terminal there, git status lists them and git checkout -- <file> undoes a change.
host_err_update_merge_failed: git couldn't apply the update. The log has the details.
host_err_git_missing: Git wasn't found. Install it (Requirements tab), then close and reopen the launcher.
host_err_upstream_old: This project folder is from before the launcher could download Mystic Paradox by itself: run Update setup (Server tab) first.
host_err_sdk_folder: That folder has no SDK.hpp. Choose Dumper-7's CppSDK folder, or the folder that holds it.
host_err_project_no_game: Choose your Dauntless 1.14.7 folder on the Play page first: the project is downloaded beside it.
host_err_project_folder_taken: There's already a Reforged folder beside the game with other files in it. Empty it, or choose the project folder yourself.
hmult_text: Private servers only, for testing: multiplies the XP the hunts give, and their rewards (Crowns, materials, part breaks, gathering, patrol chests). The reward screen still shows the normal numbers; the inventory and the levels get the multiplied ones.
hmult_range: Type a number from 1 to {max} in each field (1 is normal).
hmult_restart: A running server restarts by itself to use them (it's offline for a few seconds).
hmult_external: The server was started in a terminal: stop it there (Ctrl+C) to change them here.
hupd_text: Compares this PC's project files with the ones on GitHub. When there's an update, it downloads it, prepares the server again and restarts it if it was running. Your own files (.workspace: settings, accounts, game data and builds) stay as they are.
hupd_runtime: The game runtime changed in this update: build MysticParadox.dll again and publish it (Build tab), so your friends get it too.
hupd_note: Nothing is changed when it's already up to date.
hupd_external: The server was started in a terminal: stop it there (Ctrl+C) to update from here.
host_err_node_missing: Node.js wasn't found. Install it (Requirements tab), then close and reopen the launcher.
host_err_npm_missing: npm wasn't found next to Node.js. Reinstall Node.js with its default options.
host_err_gamedata_missing: The server has no game data yet. Generate it in the Game data tab, or use the example data for a first test.
host_err_setup_form: Fill in the server name, and the public address for a public server.
host_err_invite: The invite couldn't be made. The server details below say why.
hsrv_text_stopped: Start the server and keep the launcher open while your friends play. Closing the launcher stops the server.
hsrv_text_starting: Starting the database and the server's services. After an update the first start also builds the host kit, which takes a minute.
hsrv_text_running: Your friends can join now. Closing the launcher stops the server.
hsrv_text_stopping: Stopping every service and the game servers.
hsrv_text_external: A server started from a terminal (npm run start) is running on this PC. Stop it there with Ctrl+C to control it from here.
hsrv_text_failed_noreason: The server stopped. The details below say why.
hsrv_check_gamedata_example: Example game data (a test only: not playable)
hsrv_check_runtime: Game runtime published (without it, friends can join but not play)
hsrv_setup_text: Once, before the first start: downloads Mystic Paradox, installs and builds the services and writes the configuration. It takes a few minutes. Run it again to change the name or the kind of server (“Update setup” does it after an update).
hsrv_mode_public: Public: on the internet (advanced: needs the launcher run as administrator and open ports)
hsrv_setup_no_game: Choose your Dauntless 1.14.7 folder on the Play page first: the game servers run from it.
hsrv_setup_tailscale: A private server needs Tailscale running on this PC (Requirements tab).
hsrv_invite_text: Each invite works once. Send your friend the whole link: they paste it into the DaintyLass launcher.
hsrv_invite_tailscale: Your friend also needs Tailscale, and access to this PC: share it from the Tailscale admin console (Machines, then Share).
hgd_intro: The server needs the item catalog, the stores, the Slayer's Path and the hunt tables of your own Dauntless 1.14.7. They are generated from an export of your game made with CatalogExporter.
hgd_generate_text: Takes the newest CatalogExporter export (beside the game, or in the project) and builds every game-data file. It takes a minute; the store data is downloaded the first time.
hgd_export_none: No export yet: make one first (below).
hgd_restart: Done. Stop and start the server again to use the new game data.
hgd_export_title: Make an export from your game
hgd_step_play: Start your server, join it with this launcher and press PLAY. Wait in Ramsgate.
hgd_step_inject: Inject CatalogExporter. While it runs (up to two minutes), open the Slayer's Path screen and the hunt map.
hgd_step_generate: Close the game and press Generate game data above.
hgd_pack_text: Save everything generated into one file, to set up your next server (or this one again) without exporting again. It's your own game's data: don't publish it.
hbuild_intro: Needed once, and again after a game or project update: the SDK from your game, the runtime every player installs, and CatalogExporter for the game data.
hreq_intro: What this PC needs to host a server and build its runtime. Install what's missing, then close and reopen the launcher so it finds it.
hreq_group_build: To build the runtime and the SDK
req_dauntless_why: The game itself: the server's game servers run from it.
req_dauntless_s1: Install it as the installing guide shows (with Legendary, from your Epic account).
req_dauntless_s2: Choose its folder on the Play page.
req_git_why: Downloads Mystic Paradox while the server is prepared.
req_git_s1: Download Git for Windows and run the installer.
req_git_s2: Keep the default options. “Git from the command line and also from 3rd-party software” must stay selected.
req_node_why: Runs the server's services and the host kit.
req_node_s1: On the download page, choose the LTS version, Windows Installer (.msi), x64.
req_node_s2: Keep the default options: “Add to PATH” must stay on. The “Tools for Native Modules” box is not needed.
req_node_too_old: Version {version} is too old for the server. Install the LTS version (20.19 or newer) over it.
req_mongodb_why: The server's database. The server starts it itself.
req_mongodb_s1: On the download page, choose the current version, platform Windows x64, package msi.
req_mongodb_s3: On “Service Configuration”, untick “Install MongoD as a Service”: the server runs its own MongoDB, and the service would hold its port.
req_mongodb_s4: Untick “Install MongoDB Compass” (not needed), then finish.
req_mongodb_service_running: The MongoDB Windows service is running and holds port 27017, so the server can't start its own database. Open PowerShell as administrator and run:
req_tailscale_why: Private servers: lets your friends reach this PC without opening ports on your router.
req_tailscale_s1: Download Tailscale for Windows, install it and sign in.
req_tailscale_s2: Keep it running (its icon is next to the clock).
req_tailscale_s3: Share this PC with each friend from the Tailscale admin console (Machines, then Share).
req_visual_studio_s1: Download and run the Visual Studio 2022 Community installer.
req_visual_studio_s3: On the right, keep “MSVC v143” and a “Windows 11 SDK” ticked, then press Install (about 8 GB).
req_visual_studio_s4: Restart the PC if it asks, then reopen the launcher.
req_visual_studio_no_cpp: {version} is installed without the C++ workload. Open “Visual Studio Installer”, press Modify, tick “Desktop development with C++” and install it.
req_rust_s1: Install Visual Studio with the C++ workload first: Rust uses its build tools.
req_rust_s3: Press 1 and Enter (the default installation) and wait until it finishes.
req_dumper7_why: Generates the game's SDK, once. It is built from its source with Visual Studio.
req_dumper7_s1: Download the Dumper-7 source (ZIP) and extract it.
req_dumper7_s2: Open Dumper-7.sln with Visual Studio, choose Release and x64 at the top, then Build, Build Solution.
req_dumper7_s3: In the Build tab, choose the DLL it made (in its x64\Release folder).
req_vc_redist_why: The game needs it to start.
req_vc_redist_s2: Restart the PC if it asks.
set_verify_ok: The executable is the Dauntless 1.14.7 build.
set_verify_text: Checks that the game's executable is the Dauntless 1.14.7 build.
set_game_language_text: The language of the game's own menus and text. Automatic follows Windows, or English if the game has no text in that language. Takes effect next launch.
set_graphics_text: Applied on every launch. “In-game menu” leaves it to the game's own settings.
set_windowed_help: Starts the game in a 1280×720 window and repairs a saved window size the game can't use before every launch. Your other preferences and your account stay as they are.
set_key_note: Your key is stored encrypted on this PC and never shown.
set_backup: Save a backup of your key…
set_host_tools_text: Shows the Host page: tools to dump the game's SDK, build the game runtime, prepare the game data and publish it to your own server.
set_runtime_profile_text: Production writes short logs. Development writes detailed logs and honours the runtime's diagnostic flag files. Takes effect next launch.
set_local_runtime_text: Use runtime files from a folder on this PC instead of the server's (for hosts testing their own build).
set_streamer_help: Hides server addresses, certificate fingerprints, invites, folders and other players' names, so they don't show on stream. Click the eye next to one to show it.
set_logs_text: The launcher's log files, for when something goes wrong. Keys are never written to them.

about_credits: Based on Dauntless Revived, Mystic Paradox and Undaunted.
about_disclaimer: An unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Phoenix Labs or Epic Games. Dauntless is a trademark of its owners.
about_auto_updates: The launcher updates itself from the project's GitHub releases.
credits_intro: DaintyLass is a volunteer fan project, built on work that other people published first. Thank you, all of you.
credits_software_text: The launcher and the game runtime it installs are built with these. Their full license texts ship with the launcher in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.
credits_license_text: DaintyLass is free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0 (AGPL-3.0-only). You're entitled to its complete source code, and to the source code of the server you play on. Mystic Paradox's Dauntless 1.12.0 port and related modifications were developed by Pranav Karande; see NOTICE.md.
credits_phoenix: Dauntless is made by Phoenix Labs. DaintyLass is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Phoenix Labs or Epic Games.
trust_text: The runtime is native code that runs inside Dauntless with your Windows permissions. {name}'s host built it from the open-source Mystic Paradox runtime.
trust_detail: These are its files and their SHA-256. The launcher installs only these exact files, checks them before every launch and asks you again if the host publishes different ones.
trust_advice: Allow it only if you know the host. A runtime from a stranger could harm your PC.
logout_text: This removes your key from this PC. Without a backup of the key you can't get this account back.
leave_text: Your key for {name} stays on this PC, so you can come back with its invite.
remove_server_text: It only leaves this list. Your key for {name} stays on this PC, so you can come back any time with its invite.
certchg_text: You already have an account on {host}. This invite has a different security certificate, so it may not be your friend's server. The launcher hasn't sent anything.
certchg_advice: Continue only if your host told you they set the server up again. If you're not sure, ask them first: a fake server could take over your account.
update_ready: A new launcher version is ready.
notice_keep_open: The launcher stays open in the background while Dauntless runs: it carries the game's connection.
notice_backup_saved: Key backup saved. Keep it somewhere safe and private.
notice_runtime_installed: The game runtime is installed and checked.
notice_runtime_installed_restart: The new game runtime is installed. The worlds your server already had open keep the old one until the server restarts: restart it on the Host page.
notice_game_verified: Your game is the Dauntless 1.14.7 build.
notice_sdk_imported: SDK imported into the runtime source. Next: build.
notice_host_done: Done. The Host page shows the next step.
err_account_banned: You are banned from this server: {reason}
err_invite_invalid: The invite code was refused. It may be used up: ask the host for a new invite.
err_username_invalid: That username isn't allowed. Use 3–16 letters, numbers or _.
err_username_taken: That name is taken (upper and lower case count as the same). Try another.
err_registration_closed: Registration is closed on this server. Ask the host.
err_bad_request: The server didn't accept that. Check the name and try again.
err_server_unreachable: The server didn't answer. Check Tailscale and try again.
err_server_unreachable_public: The server didn't answer. Check your internet connection and try again.
err_server_error: The server had a problem. Try again in a moment, or tell the host.
err_key_invalid: That doesn't look like an account key.
err_key_rejected: The server didn't accept your saved account key. Register again, or use another key.
err_key_storage_unavailable: The operating system couldn't store your key securely. Try again, or restart the PC.
err_folder_invalid: The launcher can't use that folder. Pick one you own, for example in your user folder or on another drive.
err_game_folder_not_found: No Dauntless game there. Choose the Dauntless folder (the one with Archon inside).
err_game_wrong_version: That game isn't the 1.14.7 build. The private server needs exactly Dauntless 1.14.7 (changelist 647472).
err_runtime_unavailable: The server doesn't offer a game runtime yet. Ask the host.
err_runtime_untrusted: Allow the server's game runtime first.
err_runtime_failed: The game runtime couldn't be installed. Antivirus may have blocked it: check its quarantine.
err_runtime_different_on_server: A runtime file didn't match the server's list, so nothing was installed. Tell the host.
err_local_runtime_invalid: That folder doesn't hold MysticParadox.dll and winmm.dll.
err_download_failed: The download kept failing. Check your connection, then try again.
err_disk_space: Not enough free space. Free up some space, then try again.
err_already_running: Dauntless is already running. Close it first.
err_runtime_in_use: A program is holding a game runtime file and won't let it be replaced. Close Dauntless (and stop the server on the Host page, if you host one), then try again.
err_launch_failed: Dauntless didn't start. The launcher's log has the details.
err_config_failed: The game settings couldn't be written.
err_busy: Something else is still running. Try again in a moment.
err_cert_mismatch: The server's security certificate doesn't match your invite, so nothing was sent. Ask the host for a new invite.
err_cert_changed: This invite has a different security certificate than the one your key was saved with, so nothing was sent.
moved_text: You have an account on {name} at {old}. This invite is for the same server at {new}: its host probably changed Tailscale accounts.
moved_advice: Take your account along only if you trust this invite and it came from your host. Your account key is then sent to the new address.
err_rate_limited: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
err_relay_port_busy: Port {port} on this PC is already in use (another Dauntless server or launcher?). Close it, then press PLAY again.
err_relay_failed: The launcher couldn't open the game's local connection. Restart the launcher and try again.
err_host_failed: That step failed: {detail}. The log has the details.
err_unknown: Something went wrong. The launcher's log has the details.
close_text: The game reaches the server through the launcher. Closing it now disconnects the game.
dialog_runtime_folder: A folder holding MysticParadox.dll and winmm.dll
dialog_workspace_folder: Your server checkout (the folder with rust/ in it)
dialog_sdk_folder: The CppSDK folder Dumper-7 wrote (with SDK.hpp in it)
invite_err_revived: This is a Dauntless Revived invite, for a Dauntless 1.4.4 server. This launcher plays only Dauntless 1.14.7, so it can't join that server.
server_revived_disabled: This is a Dauntless Revived server, for Dauntless 1.4.4. This launcher plays only Dauntless 1.14.7, so it can't join it anymore. Your account key for it stays on this PC.
err_loader_leftovers: Files from Host tools are still next to the game's runtime loader: {detail}. Close the game, then remove them (or restart the launcher) and try again.
host_err_game_running: Close Dauntless first: this step starts the game itself.
host_err_loader_missing: The game runtime's loader (winmm.dll) isn't in the game folder. Install the runtime first (Play once, or choose a local runtime).
dialog_legacy_folder: A folder for Dauntless 1.4.4 (with the game in it, or empty)
set_game_edition_help: DaintyLass servers play Dauntless 1.14.7 (Reborn); Dauntless Revived servers play Dauntless 1.4.4 (Legacy). Each edition has its own game folder, and you join the servers of the one you pick.
edition_switch_text: {name} plays {edition}. The launcher switches to that edition, with its own game folder, and joins the server. You can switch back in Settings.
err_edition_other: This server plays the other game edition. Switch the edition in Settings to join it.
legacy_about: This server plays Dauntless 1.4.4 with Dauntless Revived's command line and client mods. Its client file, UndauntedInternalServer.dll, is DaintyLass's own build, checked by hash and loaded by the launcher's runtime loader (winmm.dll).
hint_revived_download: Press DOWNLOAD to get Dauntless 1.4.4 from the server.
hint_revived_check: Press CHECK to check the game files and fetch what is missing.
revived_download_text: This is a Dauntless Revived server: it runs Dauntless 1.4.4. The launcher downloads it from the server ({size}), checks every file and adds the Dauntless Revived client files.
revived_check_text: Dauntless 1.4.4 is in this folder. The launcher checks every file once, fetches what is missing or damaged from the server and adds the Dauntless Revived client files.
revived_check_missing: {n} files of Dauntless 1.4.4 are missing or incomplete. The launcher fetches them from the server and checks every file.
revived_choose_hint: Choose a folder that already has Dauntless 1.4.4, or an empty one to download it into.
revived_detected_title: Dauntless 1.4.4 is already on this PC
revived_installing_dlls: Adding the Dauntless Revived client files
revived_installing_text: You can stop and continue later: what is already downloaded and checked is kept.
notice_repair_done: Every Dauntless 1.4.4 file was checked; anything damaged was downloaded again.
err_manifest_mismatch: The server's list of game files is not Dauntless 1.4.4 as the launcher knows it, so nothing was downloaded.
err_no_content_server: This server doesn't offer the game download. Ask its host, or choose a folder that already has Dauntless 1.4.4.
err_file_missing_on_server: The server doesn't have a game file it should have. Ask its host.
err_file_different_on_server: A game file on the server is not the right one, so it was not kept. Ask its host.
err_dll_failed: The Dauntless Revived client files couldn't be downloaded or put next to the game. Check your connection (and your antivirus), then try again.
err_game_files_invalid: Some Dauntless 1.4.4 files are missing or changed. Press CHECK (or Check and repair).
err_folder_other_game: That folder holds another Dauntless (not 1.4.4): the launcher never downloads over it. Choose another folder.
err_folder_not_empty: That folder has other files in it. Choose an empty folder, or one that already has Dauntless 1.4.4.
err_windows_runtime_missing: Windows is missing files the game needs: install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 (x64) runtime and the DirectX End-User Runtime (June 2010), then try again.
err_compat_runtime_missing: Linux needs Proton or Wine to run the Windows game client. Install Steam Proton, Proton-GE, Wine, or Lutris Wine and try again.
err_not_implemented: This part of the launcher isn't finished yet. A later update brings it.
err_not_in_this_build: This launcher build doesn't include that.
err_epic_signed_out: Sign in to Epic Games first.
err_epic_library_failed: Couldn't check your Epic Games library. Try again in a moment.
err_epic_not_owned: This Epic Games account doesn't own Dauntless.
err_epic_code_invalid: That isn't an Epic Games sign-in code. Paste the code, or the whole page Epic shows after you sign in.
err_epic_rejected: Epic Games didn't accept that sign-in. The code may be used or expired: sign in again for a new one.
err_epic_unreachable: Couldn't reach Epic Games. Check your connection and try again.
err_epic_failed: Epic Games sign-in didn't work. Try again.
err_game_version_unknown: The launcher has no Epic Games download for that version.
err_game_version_unavailable: Epic Games no longer offers a file this version needs, so it can't be installed.
err_epic_manifest_unavailable: Couldn't get this version's file list. Check your connection and try again.
locate_epic_text: If Dauntless is in your Epic Games library, the launcher can install it for you, straight from Epic.
gm_title: Get the game from Epic Games
gm_text: Install Dauntless from your own Epic Games library. DaintyLass never hosts game files: they come straight from Epic.
gm_signed_out: You're not signed in. Sign in with the account that owns Dauntless.
gm_paste_text: If the sign-in window doesn't work, open this address in any browser, sign in, then paste the code Epic shows (or the whole page).
gm_paste_note: The code works once and isn't stored. It gives full access to your Epic Games account: never share it.
gm_library_not_owned_text: Nothing is downloaded for an account that doesn't own Dauntless. Sign out and sign in with the account that does.
gm_versions_text: Each version installs in a folder of its own, so several can sit side by side.
gm_versions_empty: There are no versions to install.
gm_ver_locate: Epic Games can't provide this version. If you already have it, choose its folder where the launcher asks for the game.
gm_ver_resumable: Stopped part-way. It continues where it left off.
gm_ver_manifest_unreachable: Couldn't read this version's file list. Check your connection and refresh.
gm_ver_manifest_invalid: This version's file list didn't check out, so it can't be installed.
gm_sign_in_first: Sign in to Epic Games to install.
gm_folder_text: Versions install in the Games/Dauntless folder in your home folder, one folder per version. To use one, press Use this install.
err_guarded_not_found: That action isn't waiting any more. Refresh the list.
err_guarded_not_waiting: That action has already run, been canceled or expired, or it waits out its delay and can't be approved early.
err_server_stopped: The server isn't running. Start it on the Server tab first.
err_module_unknown: That module isn't listed in this server's host.toml.
err_module_bad_state: The module isn't in a state that allows that.
mod_err_not_loaded: That module isn't loaded. Load it first.
err_module_input_invalid: That input doesn't fit the command.
mod_err_input_shape: The input has the wrong shape for this command.
mod_err_input_command: The module has no such command.
mod_err_input_unknown_argument: The command has no argument called {name}.
mod_err_input_argument_text: {name} must be plain text of at most 1024 characters.
mod_err_input_argument_gap: Fill in {name} too: the arguments after it need it.
err_module_settings_invalid: Those settings don't fit what the module registered.
mod_err_settings_shape: The settings have the wrong shape.
mod_err_settings_unknown_section: The module has no such settings section. Load the module first if it isn't loaded.
mod_err_settings_type: {name} has the wrong kind of value.
mod_err_failed_host_toml: The settings couldn't be saved to host.toml. The log has the details.
mod_err_failed_timeout: The module didn't answer in time.
hstat_text: Each service of the server running inside this window, and the game modules, as the controller reports them.
hstat_empty: Nothing is running. Start the server on the Server tab.
hstat_not_embedded: This server runs in a terminal, so its components can't be shown here.
mod_text: Listed in this server's host.toml. Each module's commands and settings are drawn from what it says about itself.
mod_empty: No modules are listed. Add them to [modules] in host.toml.
mod_unverified_text: Built, but not yet checked against recorded traffic from the real game. You can still load it.
mod_no_manifest: Its details show once it has loaded.
mod_cap_patch_accepts: Takes gameplay patches from a plugin
mod_commands_not_loaded: Its commands show once it has loaded.
mod_settings_none: This module registered no settings you can edit here.
mod_settings_not_loaded: Its settings show once it has loaded.
mod_settings_saved: Saved to host.toml. A running module takes the new values when it restarts.
mod_theme_text: A loaded plugin can bring its own palette and logo. Preview it on these screens before you use it.
mod_theme_none: No loaded plugin brings a look.
hsrv_mult_text: Multiply the XP and the loot the game servers grant, to reach late-game content quickly. Private servers only; restart the server for them to apply.
hsrv_update_text: Fetches the newest DaintyLass from GitHub. Stop the server first.
hsrv_update_runtime: The game runtime changed: build MysticParadox.dll again and publish it.
err_history_bad_filter: That filter isn't valid. Check the actor, the account and the times.
err_history_unavailable: There is no history to read yet. Set the server up and start it once.
err_history_plan_changed: The history changed since the dry run, or the plan is gone. Run the dry run again.
err_history_failed: The history couldn't be read or reverted: {detail}
err_realm_unavailable: Realm hosting isn't available on this server or PC.
err_realm_not_found: No realm with that ID is open right now.
